name: Averroes Signature Jollof Rice Platter
description: Richly spiced smoky Jollof rice, served with tender grilled quarter chicken, sweet fried plantains (dodo), and a crisp seasonal side salad.

name: Gourmet Egusi & Pounded Yam
description: Slow-simmered melon seed soup cooked with spinach, stockfish, and smoked prawns, served alongside smooth, warm, freshly pounded yam.

name: Truffle Beef Burger
description: A premium Wagyu beef blend patty, topped with aged cheddar, wild arugula, caramelized onions, and house-made truffle aioli on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Grilled Ribeye Steak with Herb Butter
description: A 300g choice cut ribeye steak, seasoned with sea salt and black peppercorns, flame-grilled and basted with rosemary-infused garlic butter.

name: Premium Chapman Cocktail
description: A classic Nigerian resort refresher with a secret mix of Angostura bitters, Fanta, Sprite, blackcurrant cordial, and fresh cucumber-citrus garnishes.

name: Crispy Fried Calamari with Garlic Aioli
description: Tender calamari rings dusted in seasoned flour, flash-fried to golden perfection, served with fresh lemon wedges and a zesty garlic dip.
